bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
echo POSTING_TOPIC_COVERAGE
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT t.board_key,t.purpose,count(*) AS topics,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.state='published' AND p.pinned=TRUE AND p.message_id IS NOT NULL) AS pin_ready,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.chat_id IS NULL) AS pin_absent,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'published') AS pin_not_published FROM posting_topics t LEFT JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.chat_id=t.chat_id AND p.message_thread_id=t.message_thread_id WHERE t.enabled=TRUE GROUP BY t.board_key,t.purpose ORDER BY t.board_key,t.purpose"
echo MISSING_REAL_ENTRY
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT t.chat_id,t.message_thread_id,t.title,t.purpose,COALESCE(p.state,'ABSENT') FROM posting_topics t LEFT JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.chat_id=t.chat_id AND p.message_thread_id=t.message_thread_id WHERE t.enabled=TRUE AND (p.chat_id IS NULL OR p.state<>'published' OR p.pinned IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE OR p.message_id IS NULL) ORDER BY t.chat_id,t.message_thread_id LIMIT 100"
echo COVERAGE_AUDIT_COMPLETE
